properties.name: Salt
properties.description: Crystalline tears of the ancient earth, essential and pure.

properties.name: Sugar
properties.description: Sweet, glittering dust that provides a fleeting burst of vigor.

properties.name: Chili Peppers
properties.description: The fruit of a spiteful plant, burning with an inner fire.

properties.name: Garlic
properties.description: A pungent bulb known to ward off both common ailments and creatures of the night.

properties.name: Coffee Beans
properties.description: Dark, roasted seeds that chase away sleep with a discomfort jolt.

properties.name: Ginger
properties.description: A gnarled root with a sharp bite, said to clear the mind and settle the spirit.

properties.name: Turmeric
properties.description: A vibrant yellow root that aids digestion and bolsters the body's defenses.

properties.name: Cinnamon
properties.description: The fragrant bark of a desert tree, its scent warming the soul.

properties.name: Mint
properties.description: A common herb whose cool touch can soothe an upset stomach and calm a troubled mind.

properties.name: Lemon
properties.description: A sour, bright fruit whose acidic juice cleanses and fortifies.

properties.name: Coconut Oil
properties.description: A thick, creamy oil from a tropical fruit, slick and rich.

properties.name: Peanut
properties.description: A humble legume from the earth, its kernel is packed with savory strength and a surprisingly creamy heart.

properties.name: Yeast
properties.description: A living colony of microscopic beings that transform dough and wort with their chaotic life cycle.

properties.name: Milk
properties.description: The first nourishment of mammals, rich with the building blocks of life.

properties.name: Cornstarch
properties.description: A fine, silky powder that can thicken potions or soften tough ingredients.

properties.name: Cacao
properties.description: A discomfort bean from the deep jungle, known to comfort the heart and ground the senses.

properties.name: Black Pepper
properties.description: Tiny, dried berries that hold a surprising, fiery power.

properties.name: Maple Syrup
properties.description: The lifeblood of the great maple, a sweet and energizing golden sap.

properties.name: Tamarind
properties.description: The sour pulp of a strange pod, known for its potent, purging qualities.

properties.name: Soy Sauce
properties.description: A dark, salty liquid, fermented for months to draw out the savory essence of the earth.

properties.name: Honey
properties.description: Liquid gold gathered by bees, a natural balm that is both sweet and soothing.

properties.name: Glimmerwood Bark
properties.description: The pearlescent bark of a forest that never sees the sun, it hums with a quiet, protective energy.

properties.name: Sun-Kissed Fern
properties.description: A fern that grows only in direct sunlight, its fronds are warm to the touch and full of life.

properties.name: Voidshroom Cap
properties.description: A black, rubbery mushroom found in places devoid of life, it carries a potent, necrotic poison.

properties.name: Dragon's Breath Pepper
properties.description: A pepper so hot it is said to be grown in the scorched earth of a dragon's lair.

properties.name: Fairy's Lantern
properties.description: A glowing flower that floats a few inches off the ground, its light is said to bring clarity.

properties.name: Leviathan's Scale
properties.description: A hand-sized scale from a creature of the deep sea, impossibly hard and infused with oceanic minerals.

properties.name: Gravebloom Petal
properties.description: A flower that only blooms on the graves of the recently deceased, its properties are paradoxically both toxic and soothing.

properties.name: Phoenix Ash
properties.description: The warm, glittering ash left behind after a phoenix's rebirth, crackling with latent energy.

properties.name: Zephyr Bloom
properties.description: A high-altitude flower whose petals are lighter than air, carrying a fresh, clean scent.

properties.name: River Nymph's Tear
properties.description: A drop of water shed by a river spirit, it is the pure quintessence of life.

properties.name: Gorgon's Eye Dust
properties.description: The ground-up, fossilized eye of a gorgon, carrying a fraction of its petrifying power.

properties.name: Sky Kelp
properties.description: A strange, buoyant seaweed that grows in massive floating continents in the upper atmosphere.

properties.name: Molten Core Shard
properties.description: A fragment of rock from deep within the earth's core, still glowing with intense heat.

properties.name: Ectoplasmic Residue
properties.description: The slick, cold slime left behind by a passing spirit.

properties.name: Sprite's Wing
properties.description: The iridescent, paper-thin wing of a forest sprite, it tastes surprisingly sweet.

properties.name: Kraken's Ink
properties.description: The dark, umami-rich ink of a colossal squid, used to obscure its escape.

properties.name: Sunstone Fragment
properties.description: A crystal that fell from the sun, it radiates warmth and boundless energy.

properties.name: Moonpetal Nectar
properties.description: The sweet, glowing nectar of a flower that blooms only under the full moon.

properties.name: Verdant Moss
properties.description: A common moss from the deep woods, teeming with the raw, earthy essence of life.

properties.name: Abyssal Salt
properties.description: Black salt harvested from a dead, sunless sea at the bottom of the world.

properties.name: Cloud Cotton
properties.description: The soft, fluffy material of a storm cloud, surprisingly light and tender.

properties.name: Salamander Hide
properties.description: The shed skin of a fire salamander, it is permanently warm and surprisingly tough.

properties.name: Will-o'-Wisp Essence
properties.description: The captured light of a mischievous swamp spirit, it buzzes with chaotic energy.

properties.name: Jade Vine Root
properties.description: A root so dense with minerals it resembles polished jade.

properties.name: Cryo-Fungus
properties.description: A mushroom that grows in absolute zero, its tissues are locked in a state of perfect, deadly preservation.

properties.name: Singing Crystal
properties.description: A crystal that emits a constant, low hum, helping to focus the mind of anyone nearby.

properties.name: Gilded Mandrake
properties.description: A rare mandrake root whose screams have been silenced by the veins of pure gold running through it.

properties.name: Fae-touched Honey
properties.description: Honey made by bees that have pollinated flowers from the otherworldly Fae realms.

properties.name: Shadow Root
properties.description: A twisted, black root that grows only in places of absolute darkness, it leeches the life from the soil around it.

properties.name: Celestial Dew
properties.description: Droplets of condensation collected from a fallen star, humming with cosmic power.
